scope: Four V9 historical PR pairs; post-evaluation adversarial comparison, not a new blinded reference. Population predictions read solely for separately authorized omission audit.
conclusion: No material full-only issue was shown to disappear because of candidate omission. PR303 categorizes the same concern differently; PR300 full includes an extra label-overwrite subcase despite identical available core evidence. This does not establish review parity or defect recall.

pairs.comparison: Full arm placed minc emission in findings; candidate explicitly raised the same condition and minc concern in unknowns/summary. This is finding-versus-uncertainty categorization, not lost issue recognition.
pairs.omission_causality: The only omitted declaration is initGraphRankEnv, a test setup helper. Init and Seek evidence is identical in both arms; no support that removing the helper caused the different categorization.
pairs.source_adjudication: The normal BuildStack validates contexts and GraphRank registry permits majc/offline, not minc or scan. This weakens the full finding on normal stack construction; direct unsupported Init use was not exhaustively excluded. No demonstrated introduced minc vulnerability.

pairs.comparison: Both arms identify missing per-principal authorization in EmbeddedService.ActiveOntology, including unmapped authenticated callers. Candidate elaborates exposed constraint literals; full adds no distinct material finding.
pairs.omission_causality: ActiveOntology evidence is retained identically. Candidate loses configuration/parser visibility and reports those unknowns, but the shared authorization concern survives.
pairs.source_adjudication: Pinned ActiveOntology returns configured schema without consulting a decision; ServeHTTP authenticates then dispatches without a route-operation check. This supports the local missing-check observation. Intended schema visibility and full binder semantics still require confirmation before calling it a defect.

pairs.comparison: Both arms identify aggregation under weaker vertex visibility, missing-label fallback, and tombstone handling. Severity differs. Full additionally mentions multiple label cells overwriting visibility; candidate only explicitly describes missing-label fallback.
pairs.material_full_only_finding: One additional full-only subcase: multiple label cells with differing visibilities. It is part of the shared arbitrary-label-selection concern, not independently established defect truth.
pairs.omission_causality: Seek is byte-identical in both arms and contains the unconditional label overwrite. The additional subcase requires no omitted declaration. Stochastic coverage/wording is plausible; omission causality is not demonstrated. Candidate explicitly reports loss of option/setup context.
pairs.source_adjudication: Seek gathers edge influence without combining edge security labels, selects first vertex-cell visibility then overwrites on labelCQ, and does not inspect Deleted. These local facts are visible. Exploitability, deletion propagation at actual host stacks, schema guarantees, and intended parity remain unresolved; no runtime reproduction.

pairs.comparison: Both arms report derivation/assertion endpoint binding absent in Assertion.Validate. Candidate notes omitted constructors/validators and preserves the same core concern.
pairs.omission_causality: Assertion.Validate is retained identically, including the origin/evidence checks and lack of direct endpoint comparison. No evidence that omission removed the shared concern.
pairs.source_adjudication: Local lack of binding is supported by the validator body, but a general attribution/data-integrity issue is not automatically an authorization defect under the fixed narrow rubric. Downstream trust use and intended attribution contract require investigation; neither arm provides ground truth.

limitations: One stochastic review per arm per PR, four selected PRs; not prospective evidence or sufficient power for parity.
Both arms are partial evidence packets, not whole repository reviews.
Findings are model proposals and source-local observations, not validated defects; no tests run.
Earlier relevance judgments are not defect ground truth and were not edited.
No counterfactual reruns isolating a single omitted declaration; cannot attribute wording differences causally to reduction.
Nominal omitted-function counts differ from evidence/token reduction and cannot alone establish savings.
